question: Stage 2: how should the Hugo website consume the content (same repo with a Hugo theme, or a separate site repo pulling content/)?
probes: Ask the person which Hugo site/theme and repo layout they use
resolution: Settled by the person's earlier answers: stage 2 = local folder sync. The app writes Hugo page bundles into the blog's content folder (sync folder, e.g. ~/letsanders/nachgedanken/data/content with hugo.toml one level up); Git and the Hugo build are handled by the person outside the app ('Durch Git ist das ja alles abgedeckt'). Settings now show when the sync folder belongs to a Hugo site.
